## REWIND tint driver (CHANGE-BRIEF A5.2): gives one fighter's body sprite its
## own ShaderMaterial and fades `rewind_amount` from the fighter's state.
##
## Read-only: it reads `fighter.state` and `game.paused` and never writes game
## state. move_toward from the current value gives R3 (extend) and R5 (fade out
## from where it is); `delta` is scaled game time (R4a).

const FADE_IN := 0.15
const FADE_OUT := 0.30

var fighter: Fighter
var game
var material: ShaderMaterial
var amount := 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE   # main is ALWAYS; freeze on tree pause (R4b)
	material = ShaderMaterial.new()             # one per fighter (R6)
	material.shader = preload("res://shaders/rewind_tint.gdshader")
	fighter.sprite.material = material
	material.set_shader_parameter("rewind_amount", amount)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if game.paused:
		return                                  # the fight is frozen, so is the tint (R4c)
	var target := 1.0 if fighter.state == Fighter.S.REWIND else 0.0
	var rate := 1.0 / (FADE_IN if target > amount else FADE_OUT)
	amount = move_toward(amount, target, rate * delta)
	material.set_shader_parameter("rewind_amount", amount)

extends Node2D
## Tin Knockout asset slice: one round, Bolt (player) vs Rivet (pattern opponent)
## at the bottom of an empty goldfish bowl.
##
## Round flow: TITLE -> INTRO ("ROUND 1") -> FIGHT (bell) -> KO (bell, music
## stops) -> R / Enter -> INTRO again. Pause (Esc/P) freezes the fight and
## muffles the music. M / N mute music / effects separately.

signal round_changed(state: int)

enum R { TITLE, INTRO, FIGHT, KO }
const FLOOR_Y := 292.0     # sand floor of ENV-BOWL (80% of frame height)
const ARENA := Vector2(132, 500)  # inside the bowl's glass
const INTRO_TIME := 1.3
const LOW_WIND := 25.0

var round_state: int = R.TITLE
var round_t := 0.0
var paused := false
var show_boxes := false
var winner: Fighter

var bolt: Fighter
var rivet: Fighter
var brain
var corks: Array = []
var sfx
var music
var hud
var cam: Camera2D
var bg: Sprite2D
var shake := 0.0
var roll := 0.0
var sparks: Array = []   # [pos, t]
var fx: Node2D           # drawn above the fighters

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	cam = Camera2D.new()
	cam.position = Vector2(320, 180)
	add_child(cam)
	bg = Sprite2D.new()
	bg.centered = false
	bg.z_index = -10
	if ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/env/bowl.png"):
		bg.texture = load("res://assets/env/bowl.png")
		bg.scale = Vector2(640.0 / bg.texture.get_width(), 360.0 / bg.texture.get_height())
	add_child(bg)

	bolt = Fighter.new()
	bolt.skin = "bolt"
	rivet = Fighter.new()
	rivet.skin = "rivet"
	for f in [bolt, rivet]:
		f.position.y = FLOOR_Y
		f.arena_min = ARENA.x
		f.arena_max = ARENA.y
		f.spawn_cork = _spawn_cork
		add_child(f)
		f.hit_landed.connect(_on_hit)
	bolt.opponent = rivet
	rivet.opponent = bolt
	brain = preload("res://fighter/rivet_brain.gd").new()
	brain.me = rivet

	sfx = preload("res://audio/sfx.gd").new()
	add_child(sfx)
	sfx.watch(bolt)
	sfx.watch(rivet)
	round_changed.connect(func(s):
		if s == R.FIGHT or s == R.KO:
			sfx.play("bell"))
	music = preload("res://audio/music.gd").new()
	add_child(music)
	bolt.wind_changed.connect(func(_f, w):
		if round_state == R.FIGHT:
			music.set_low_wind(w < LOW_WIND))

	fx = Node2D.new()
	fx.z_index = 5
	add_child(fx)
	fx.draw.connect(_draw_fx)
	hud = preload("res://ui/hud.gd").new()
	hud.game = self
	add_child(hud)
	_reset_fighters()
	_set_round(R.TITLE)
	music.title()

func _reset_fighters() -> void:
	for c in corks:
		if is_instance_valid(c):
			c.queue_free()
	corks.clear()
	bolt.reset(200, 1)
	rivet.reset(440, -1)
	if brain and brain.get("pop_cd") != null:
		brain.pop_cd = 1.5
	winner = null

func _set_round(s: int) -> void:
	round_state = s
	round_t = 0.0
	round_changed.emit(s)

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event.is_action_pressed("mute_music"):
		var b := AudioServer.get_bus_index(&"Music")
		AudioServer.set_bus_mute(b, not AudioServer.is_bus_mute(b))
	elif event.is_action_pressed("mute_sfx"):
		var b := AudioServer.get_bus_index(&"SFX")
		AudioServer.set_bus_mute(b, not AudioServer.is_bus_mute(b))
	elif event.is_action_pressed("debug_boxes"):
		show_boxes = not show_boxes
	elif event.is_action_pressed("pause") and round_state == R.FIGHT:
		paused = not paused
		music.set_paused(paused)
	elif round_state == R.TITLE and event.is_action_pressed("confirm"):
		_set_round(R.INTRO)
	elif round_state == R.KO and (event.is_action_pressed("rematch") or event.is_action_pressed("confirm")):
		_reset_fighters()
		_set_round(R.INTRO)

func _physics_process(dt: float) -> void:
	round_t += dt
	match round_state:
		R.INTRO:
			for f in [bolt, rivet]:
				f.intent = {"move": 0, "jab": false, "cutlass": false, "pop": false, "block": false, "rewind": false}
			if round_t >= INTRO_TIME:
				_set_round(R.FIGHT)
				music.fight_start()
		R.FIGHT:
			if not paused:
				_read_player()
				brain.think(dt)
				_simulate(dt)
				if bolt.is_out() or rivet.is_out():
					winner = rivet if bolt.is_out() else bolt
					winner.win()
					music.knockout()
					roll = 0.45
					_set_round(R.KO)
		R.KO:
			bolt.intent = {"move": 0, "jab": false, "cutlass": false, "pop": false, "block": false, "rewind": false}
			_simulate(dt)
	_effects(dt)
	hud.redraw()
	fx.queue_redraw()

func _read_player() -> void:
	bolt.intent = {
		"move": int(Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")),
		"jab": Input.is_action_just_pressed("jab"),
		"cutlass": Input.is_action_just_pressed("cutlass"),
		"pop": Input.is_action_just_pressed("pop"),
		"block": Input.is_action_pressed("block"),
		"rewind": Input.is_action_pressed("rewind"),
	}

func _simulate(dt: float) -> void:
	bolt.step(dt)
	rivet.step(dt)
	# tin bodies don't pass through each other
	var gap := rivet.position.x - bolt.position.x
	var min_gap := 44.0
	if absf(gap) < min_gap:
		var side := signf(gap) if gap != 0.0 else 1.0
		var fix := (min_gap - absf(gap)) / 2.0
		bolt.position.x -= side * fix
		rivet.position.x += side * fix
	for c in corks.duplicate():
		if is_instance_valid(c):
			c.step(dt)
		else:
			corks.erase(c)

func _spawn_cork(f: Fighter) -> void:
	var c := Sprite2D.new()
	c.set_script(preload("res://fighter/cork.gd"))
	c.owner_fighter = f
	c.dir = f.facing
	var pa: Dictionary = f.anchors.get("pop", {})
	var m: Array = pa.get("muzzle", [60, -64])
	c.position = f.position + Vector2(m[0] * f.facing, m[1])
	if ResourceLoader.exists("res://assets/props/cork.png"):
		c.texture = load("res://assets/props/cork.png")
		c.scale = Vector2.ONE * (14.0 / c.texture.get_width())
	add_child(c)
	sfx.watch_cork(c)
	c.struck.connect(func(cork, _blocked): _on_impact(cork.position))
	corks.append(c)

func _on_hit(attacker: Fighter, _attack: String, _blocked: bool) -> void:
	var box := attacker.attack_box()
	_on_impact(box.get_center() if box.has_area() else attacker.opponent.position + Vector2(0, -70))

func _on_impact(p: Vector2) -> void:
	sparks.append([p, 0.14])
	shake = 0.15
	if bolt.state == Fighter.S.HURT and bolt.stun >= Fighter.KNOCKDOWN_TIME:
		roll = 0.45   # knockdown: Dutch-angle camera roll (storyboard panel 5)

func _effects(dt: float) -> void:
	shake = maxf(0.0, shake - dt)
	roll = maxf(0.0, roll - dt)
	cam.offset = Vector2(randf_range(-3, 3), randf_range(-3, 3)) if shake > 0.0 else Vector2.ZERO
	cam.rotation = deg_to_rad(5.0) * (roll / 0.45) if roll > 0.0 else 0.0
	for s in sparks:
		s[1] -= dt
	sparks = sparks.filter(func(s): return s[1] > 0.0)

func _draw_fx() -> void:
	for s in sparks:
		var k: float = s[1] / 0.14
		var pts := PackedVector2Array()
		for i in 16:
			var r := (14.0 if i % 2 == 0 else 6.0) * (1.4 - k * 0.4)
			pts.append(s[0] + Vector2.from_angle(i * TAU / 16.0) * r)
		fx.draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(1, 0.95, 0.6, k))
	if show_boxes:
		for f in [bolt, rivet]:
			fx.draw_rect(f.hurtbox(), Color(0.1, 0.9, 0.3), false, 1.0)
			var ab: Rect2 = f.attack_box()
			if ab.has_area():
				fx.draw_rect(ab, Color(1, 0.2, 0.2), false, 1.0)
		for c in corks:
			if is_instance_valid(c):
				fx.draw_rect(Rect2(c.position - Vector2(5, 5), Vector2(10, 10)), Color(1, 0.2, 0.2), false, 1.0)

extends SceneTree
## Automated checks for the A5 REWIND tint (CHANGE-BRIEF A5.2, rules R1-R6).
##   scripts/run-test.sh test_rewind_tint.gd <30|60|144>
##
## State is driven through the REAL game loop and input path: rewind is held
## with Input.action_press, pause is a parsed input event, Rivet acts only
## through a brain's think() (the hook rivet_brain.gd uses). The driver's update
## is never called. A Sampler node with process_priority 1000 reads each
## material's `rewind_amount` after every other _process() in the frame.
##
## Headless limits (CLAUDE.md, evidence/a5/headless-facts.txt): nothing is drawn
## and a parameter readback only proves what the driver set, not what the GPU
## shows. Shader defaults are read from the .gdshader text.
## Exit code = number of failed checks.

const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/rewind_tint.gdshader"
const FADE_IN := 0.15
const FADE_OUT := 0.30
const EPS := 1e-4

var main
var sampler: Sampler
var failures := 0
var checks := 0
var period := 1.0 / 60.0   # one frame at --fixed-fps, read from the command line

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func ok(cond: bool, what: String) -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not cond:
		failures += 1
	print(("PASS  " if cond else "FAIL  ") + what)

## Reads both materials after every other _process() (priority 1000), and keeps
## sampling while the tree is paused.
class Sampler extends Node:
	var game
	var t := 0.0
	var log: Array = []
	func _ready() -> void:
		process_priority = 1000
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		t += delta
		if game == null or not is_instance_valid(game) or not game.is_inside_tree():
			return
		log.append({"t": t, "dt": delta,
			"b": game.bolt.sprite.material.get_shader_parameter("rewind_amount"),
			"r": game.rivet.sprite.material.get_shader_parameter("rewind_amount"),
			"bs": game.bolt.state, "rs": game.rivet.state, "gp": game.paused})

class FrozenBrain:
	func think(_dt): pass

## Rivet acts only through intent, like rivet_brain.gd: one jab tick, or held rewind.
class ScriptedBrain:
	var me: Fighter
	var jabs := 0
	var rewind := false
	func think(_dt):
		me.intent = {"move": 0, "jab": jabs > 0, "cutlass": false, "pop": false, "block": false, "rewind": rewind}
		jabs = maxi(0, jabs - 1)

func physics_frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame

func frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await process_frame

## Waits (process frames) until cond(last sample) holds. Returns false on timeout.
func until(cond: Callable, max_frames := 2000) -> bool:
	for i in max_frames:
		await process_frame
		if sampler.log.size() > 0 and cond.call(sampler.log[-1]):
			return true
	return false

func press_event(action: String) -> void:
	for pressed in [true, false]:
		var ev := InputEventAction.new()
		ev.action = action
		ev.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(ev)
		await physics_frames(1)

func fresh(brain = null) -> void:
	Input.action_release("rewind")
	if main:
		main.queue_free()
		await physics_frames(2)
	main = load("res://game/main.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(main)
	await physics_frames(2)
	if brain == null:
		brain = FrozenBrain.new()
	if brain is ScriptedBrain:
		brain.me = main.rivet
	main.brain = brain                  # SETUP: replace Rivet's brain BEFORE the fight starts
	main._set_round(main.R.INTRO)
	await physics_frames(int(main.INTRO_TIME * 60) + 3)
	sampler.game = main
	await frames(2)

## Index of the first sample at or after `from` matching cond, or -1.
func find(from: int, cond: Callable) -> int:
	for i in range(from, sampler.log.size()):
		if cond.call(sampler.log[i]):
			return i
	return -1

func max_dt(a: int, b: int) -> float:
	var m := 0.0
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		m = maxf(m, sampler.log[i].dt)
	return m

## R1: across [a, b] Bolt's value only rises on REWIND frames and only falls off them.
func direction_follows_state(a: int, b: int, key := "b", state_key := "bs") -> bool:
	for i in range(maxi(a, 1), b + 1):
		var s: Dictionary = sampler.log[i]
		var prev: float = sampler.log[i - 1][key]
		if s[key] > prev and s[state_key] != Fighter.S.REWIND:
			return false
		if s[key] < prev and s[state_key] == Fighter.S.REWIND:
			return false
	return true

func all_equal(a: int, b: int, key: String, value: float) -> bool:
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		if sampler.log[i][key] != value:
			return false
	return true

func run() -> void:
	var args := OS.get_cmdline_args()
	var k := args.find("--fixed-fps")
	if k >= 0 and k + 1 < args.size():
		period = 1.0 / float(args[k + 1])
	print("frame period %.6f s (%d fps)" % [period, roundi(1.0 / period)])
	sampler = Sampler.new()
	root.add_child(sampler)
	await test_shader_contract()
	await test_materials_and_rest()
	await test_fade_in_and_out()
	await test_retrigger_extends()
	await test_release_mid_fade_in()
	await test_hit_mid_fade_in()
	await test_time_scale()
	await test_tree_pause()
	await test_game_pause()
	await test_rivet_alone()
	Input.action_release("rewind")
	print("\n%d checks, %d failed" % [checks, failures])
	quit(failures)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## A5.2 uniform table: names and types from the engine, defaults and hints from the text.
func test_shader_contract() -> void:
	var shader: Shader = load(SHADER_PATH)
	var list := shader.get_shader_uniform_list()
	var by_name := {}
	for u in list:
		by_name[u.name] = u
	print("      uniforms: ", list.map(func(u): return "%s type=%d" % [u.name, u.type]))
	ok(list.size() == 3, "shader parsed: exactly 3 uniforms listed (got %d)" % list.size())
	ok(by_name.has("rewind_amount") and by_name.rewind_amount.type == TYPE_FLOAT, "rewind_amount is a float (type 3)")
	ok(by_name.has("tint_color") and by_name.tint_color.type == TYPE_COLOR, "tint_color is vec4 : source_color (type 20)")
	ok(by_name.has("tint_strength") and by_name.tint_strength.type == TYPE_FLOAT, "tint_strength is a float (type 3)")

	var src := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SHADER_PATH)
	var re := RegEx.new()
	re.compile("uniform\\s+float\\s+rewind_amount\\s*:\\s*hint_range\\(\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*,\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*\\)\\s*=\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*;")
	var m := re.search(src)
	ok(m != null and float(m.get_string(1)) == 0.0 and float(m.get_string(2)) == 1.0 and float(m.get_string(3)) == 0.0,
		"source: rewind_amount hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.0")
	re.compile("uniform\\s+float\\s+tint_strength\\s*:\\s*hint_range\\(\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*,\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*\\)\\s*=\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*;")
	m = re.search(src)
	ok(m != null and float(m.get_string(1)) == 0.0 and float(m.get_string(2)) == 1.0 and float(m.get_string(3)) == 0.5,
		"source: tint_strength hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.5")
	re.compile("uniform\\s+vec4\\s+tint_color\\s*:\\s*source_color\\s*=\\s*vec4\\(([^)]*)\\)\\s*;")
	m = re.search(src)
	var c := PackedFloat64Array()
	if m:
		for part in m.get_string(1).split(","):
			c.append(float(part.strip_edges()))
	ok(c == PackedFloat64Array([0.353, 0.627, 1.0, 1.0]), "source: tint_color = vec4(0.353, 0.627, 1.0, 1.0) (got %s)" % [c])

## R6 wiring and R1 at rest; only the two body sprites carry a material.
func test_materials_and_rest() -> void:
	await fresh()
	var bm = main.bolt.sprite.material
	var rm = main.rivet.sprite.material

	func _ready() -> void:
		process_priority = 1000
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS

	for i in n:
		await process_frame

	for i in max_frames:

	return false

## Automated checks for the A5 REWIND tint (CHANGE-BRIEF A5.2, rules R1-R6).
##   scripts/run-test.sh test_rewind_tint.gd <30|60|144>
##
## State is driven through the REAL game loop and input path: rewind is held
## with Input.action_press, pause is a parsed input event, Rivet acts only
## through a brain's think() (the hook rivet_brain.gd uses). The driver's update
## is never called. A Sampler node with process_priority 1000 reads each
## material's `rewind_amount` after every other _process() in the frame.
##
## Headless limits (CLAUDE.md, evidence/a5/headless-facts.txt): nothing is drawn
## and a parameter readback only proves what the driver set, not what the GPU
## shows. Shader defaults are read from the .gdshader text.
## Exit code = number of failed checks.

const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/rewind_tint.gdshader"
const FADE_IN := 0.15
const FADE_OUT := 0.30
const EPS := 1e-4

var main
var sampler: Sampler
var failures := 0
var checks := 0
var period := 1.0 / 60.0   # one frame at --fixed-fps, read from the command line

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func ok(cond: bool, what: String) -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not cond:
		failures += 1
	print(("PASS  " if cond else "FAIL  ") + what)

## Reads both materials after every other _process() (priority 1000), and keeps
## sampling while the tree is paused.
class Sampler extends Node:
	var game
	var t := 0.0
	var log: Array = []
	func _ready() -> void:
		process_priority = 1000
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		t += delta
		if game == null or not is_instance_valid(game) or not game.is_inside_tree():
			return
		log.append({"t": t, "dt": delta,
			"b": game.bolt.sprite.material.get_shader_parameter("rewind_amount"),
			"r": game.rivet.sprite.material.get_shader_parameter("rewind_amount"),
			"bs": game.bolt.state, "rs": game.rivet.state, "gp": game.paused})

class FrozenBrain:
	func think(_dt): pass

## Rivet acts only through intent, like rivet_brain.gd: one jab tick, or held rewind.
class ScriptedBrain:
	var me: Fighter
	var jabs := 0
	var rewind := false
	func think(_dt):
		me.intent = {"move": 0, "jab": jabs > 0, "cutlass": false, "pop": false, "block": false, "rewind": rewind}
		jabs = maxi(0, jabs - 1)

func physics_frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame

func frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await process_frame

## Waits (process frames) until cond(last sample) holds. Returns false on timeout.
func until(cond: Callable, max_frames := 2000) -> bool:
	for i in max_frames:
		await process_frame
		if sampler.log.size() > 0 and cond.call(sampler.log[-1]):
			return true
	return false

func press_event(action: String) -> void:
	for pressed in [true, false]:
		var ev := InputEventAction.new()
		ev.action = action
		ev.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(ev)
		await physics_frames(1)

func fresh(brain = null) -> void:
	Input.action_release("rewind")
	if main:
		main.queue_free()
		await physics_frames(2)
	main = load("res://game/main.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(main)
	await physics_frames(2)
	if brain == null:
		brain = FrozenBrain.new()
	if brain is ScriptedBrain:
		brain.me = main.rivet
	main.brain = brain                  # SETUP: replace Rivet's brain BEFORE the fight starts
	main._set_round(main.R.INTRO)
	await physics_frames(int(main.INTRO_TIME * 60) + 3)
	sampler.game = main
	await frames(2)

## Index of the first sample at or after `from` matching cond, or -1.
func find(from: int, cond: Callable) -> int:
	for i in range(from, sampler.log.size()):
		if cond.call(sampler.log[i]):
			return i
	return -1

func max_dt(a: int, b: int) -> float:
	var m := 0.0
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		m = maxf(m, sampler.log[i].dt)
	return m

## R1: across [a, b] Bolt's value only rises on REWIND frames and only falls off them.
func direction_follows_state(a: int, b: int, key := "b", state_key := "bs") -> bool:
	for i in range(maxi(a, 1), b + 1):
		var s: Dictionary = sampler.log[i]
		var prev: float = sampler.log[i - 1][key]
		if s[key] > prev and s[state_key] != Fighter.S.REWIND:
			return false
		if s[key] < prev and s[state_key] == Fighter.S.REWIND:
			return false
	return true

func all_equal(a: int, b: int, key: String, value: float) -> bool:
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		if sampler.log[i][key] != value:
			return false
	return true

func run() -> void:
	var args := OS.get_cmdline_args()
	var k := args.find("--fixed-fps")
	if k >= 0 and k + 1 < args.size():
		period = 1.0 / float(args[k + 1])
	print("frame period %.6f s (%d fps)" % [period, roundi(1.0 / period)])
	sampler = Sampler.new()
	root.add_child(sampler)
	await test_shader_contract()
	await test_materials_and_rest()
	await test_fade_in_and_out()
	await test_retrigger_extends()
	await test_release_mid_fade_in()
	await test_hit_mid_fade_in()
	await test_time_scale()
	await test_tree_pause()
	await test_game_pause()
	await test_rivet_alone()
	Input.action_release("rewind")
	print("\n%d checks, %d failed" % [checks, failures])
	quit(failures)

## R1 + R2: hold rewind, fade in 0.15 s; release, fade out 0.30 s.
func test_fade_in_and_out() -> void:
	await fresh()
	var a := sampler.log.size()
	Input.action_press("rewind")
	ok(await until(func(s): return s.b == 1.0), "R1 holding rewind: Bolt's value reaches 1.0")
	var b := sampler.log.size() - 1
	var first := find(a, func(s): return s.b > 0.0)
	var t_press: float = sampler.log[a - 1].t

	Input.action_press("rewind")

##   scripts/run-test.sh test_rewind_tint.gd <30|60|144>
##
## State is driven through the REAL game loop and input path: rewind is held
## with Input.action_press, pause is a parsed input event, Rivet acts only
## through a brain's think() (the hook rivet_brain.gd uses). The driver's update
## is never called. A Sampler node with process_priority 1000 reads each
## material's `rewind_amount` after every other _process() in the frame.
##
## Headless limits (CLAUDE.md, evidence/a5/headless-facts.txt): nothing is drawn
## and a parameter readback only proves what the driver set, not what the GPU
## shows. Shader defaults are read from the .gdshader text.
## Exit code = number of failed checks.

const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/rewind_tint.gdshader"
const FADE_IN := 0.15
const FADE_OUT := 0.30
const EPS := 1e-4

var main
var sampler: Sampler
var failures := 0
var checks := 0
var period := 1.0 / 60.0   # one frame at --fixed-fps, read from the command line

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func ok(cond: bool, what: String) -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not cond:
		failures += 1
	print(("PASS  " if cond else "FAIL  ") + what)

## Reads both materials after every other _process() (priority 1000), and keeps
## sampling while the tree is paused.
class Sampler extends Node:
	var game
	var t := 0.0
	var log: Array = []
	func _ready() -> void:
		process_priority = 1000
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		t += delta
		if game == null or not is_instance_valid(game) or not game.is_inside_tree():
			return
		log.append({"t": t, "dt": delta,
			"b": game.bolt.sprite.material.get_shader_parameter("rewind_amount"),
			"r": game.rivet.sprite.material.get_shader_parameter("rewind_amount"),
			"bs": game.bolt.state, "rs": game.rivet.state, "gp": game.paused})

class FrozenBrain:
	func think(_dt): pass

## Rivet acts only through intent, like rivet_brain.gd: one jab tick, or held rewind.
class ScriptedBrain:
	var me: Fighter
	var jabs := 0
	var rewind := false
	func think(_dt):
		me.intent = {"move": 0, "jab": jabs > 0, "cutlass": false, "pop": false, "block": false, "rewind": rewind}
		jabs = maxi(0, jabs - 1)

func physics_frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame

func frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await process_frame

## Waits (process frames) until cond(last sample) holds. Returns false on timeout.
func until(cond: Callable, max_frames := 2000) -> bool:
	for i in max_frames:
		await process_frame
		if sampler.log.size() > 0 and cond.call(sampler.log[-1]):
			return true
	return false

func press_event(action: String) -> void:
	for pressed in [true, false]:
		var ev := InputEventAction.new()
		ev.action = action
		ev.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(ev)
		await physics_frames(1)

func fresh(brain = null) -> void:
	Input.action_release("rewind")
	if main:
		main.queue_free()
		await physics_frames(2)
	main = load("res://game/main.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(main)
	await physics_frames(2)

## Index of the first sample at or after `from` matching cond, or -1.
func find(from: int, cond: Callable) -> int:
	for i in range(from, sampler.log.size()):
		if cond.call(sampler.log[i]):
			return i
	return -1

func max_dt(a: int, b: int) -> float:
	var m := 0.0
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		m = maxf(m, sampler.log[i].dt)
	return m

func direction_follows_state(a: int, b: int, key := "b", state_key := "bs") -> bool:
	for i in range(maxi(a, 1), b + 1):
		var s: Dictionary = sampler.log[i]
		var prev: float = sampler.log[i - 1][key]
		if s[key] > prev and s[state_key] != Fighter.S.REWIND:
			return false
		if s[key] < prev and s[state_key] == Fighter.S.REWIND:
			return false
	return true

	for i in range(a, b + 1):

## Automated checks for the A5 REWIND tint (CHANGE-BRIEF A5.2, rules R1-R6).
##   scripts/run-test.sh test_rewind_tint.gd <30|60|144>
##
## State is driven through the REAL game loop and input path: rewind is held
## with Input.action_press, pause is a parsed input event, Rivet acts only
## through a brain's think() (the hook rivet_brain.gd uses). The driver's update
## is never called. A Sampler node with process_priority 1000 reads each
## material's `rewind_amount` after every other _process() in the frame.
##
## Headless limits (CLAUDE.md, evidence/a5/headless-facts.txt): nothing is drawn
## and a parameter readback only proves what the driver set, not what the GPU
## shows. Shader defaults are read from the .gdshader text.
## Exit code = number of failed checks.

const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/rewind_tint.gdshader"
const FADE_IN := 0.15
const FADE_OUT := 0.30
const EPS := 1e-4

var main
var sampler: Sampler
var failures := 0
var checks := 0
var period := 1.0 / 60.0   # one frame at --fixed-fps, read from the command line

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func ok(cond: bool, what: String) -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not cond:
		failures += 1
	print(("PASS  " if cond else "FAIL  ") + what)

## Reads both materials after every other _process() (priority 1000), and keeps
## sampling while the tree is paused.
class Sampler extends Node:
	var game
	var t := 0.0
	var log: Array = []
	func _ready() -> void:
		process_priority = 1000
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		t += delta
		if game == null or not is_instance_valid(game) or not game.is_inside_tree():
			return
		log.append({"t": t, "dt": delta,
			"b": game.bolt.sprite.material.get_shader_parameter("rewind_amount"),
			"r": game.rivet.sprite.material.get_shader_parameter("rewind_amount"),
			"bs": game.bolt.state, "rs": game.rivet.state, "gp": game.paused})

class FrozenBrain:
	func think(_dt): pass

## Rivet acts only through intent, like rivet_brain.gd: one jab tick, or held rewind.
class ScriptedBrain:
	var me: Fighter
	var jabs := 0
	var rewind := false
	func think(_dt):
		me.intent = {"move": 0, "jab": jabs > 0, "cutlass": false, "pop": false, "block": false, "rewind": rewind}
		jabs = maxi(0, jabs - 1)

func physics_frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame

func frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await process_frame

## Waits (process frames) until cond(last sample) holds. Returns false on timeout.
func until(cond: Callable, max_frames := 2000) -> bool:
	for i in max_frames:
		await process_frame
		if sampler.samples.size() > 0 and cond.call(sampler.samples[-1]):
			return true
	return false

func press_event(action: String) -> void:
	for pressed in [true, false]:
		var ev := InputEventAction.new()
		ev.action = action
		ev.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(ev)
		await physics_frames(1)

func fresh(brain = null) -> void:
	Input.action_release("rewind")
	if main:
		main.queue_free()
		await physics_frames(2)
	main = load("res://game/main.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(main)
	await physics_frames(2)
	if brain == null:
		brain = FrozenBrain.new()
	if brain is ScriptedBrain:
		brain.me = main.rivet
	main.brain = brain                  # SETUP: replace Rivet's brain BEFORE the fight starts
	main._set_round(main.R.INTRO)
	await physics_frames(int(main.INTRO_TIME * 60) + 3)
	sampler.game = main
	await frames(2)

## Index of the first sample at or after `from` matching cond, or -1.
func find(from: int, cond: Callable) -> int:
	for i in range(from, sampler.samples.size()):
		if cond.call(sampler.samples[i]):
			return i
	return -1

func max_dt(a: int, b: int) -> float:
	var m := 0.0
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		m = maxf(m, sampler.samples[i].dt)
	return m

## R1: across [a, b] Bolt's value only rises on REWIND frames and only falls off them.
func direction_follows_state(a: int, b: int, key := "b", state_key := "bs") -> bool:
	for i in range(maxi(a, 1), b + 1):
		var s: Dictionary = sampler.samples[i]
		var prev: float = sampler.samples[i - 1][key]
		if s[key] > prev and s[state_key] != Fighter.S.REWIND:
			return false
		if s[key] < prev and s[state_key] == Fighter.S.REWIND:
			return false
	return true

func all_equal(a: int, b: int, key: String, value: float) -> bool:
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		if sampler.samples[i][key] != value:
			return false
	return true

func run() -> void:
	var args := OS.get_cmdline_args()
	var k := args.find("--fixed-fps")
	if k >= 0 and k + 1 < args.size():
		period = 1.0 / float(args[k + 1])
	print("frame period %.6f s (%d fps)" % [period, roundi(1.0 / period)])
	sampler = Sampler.new()
	root.add_child(sampler)
	await test_shader_contract()
	await test_materials_and_rest()
	await test_fade_in_and_out()
	await test_retrigger_extends()
	await test_release_mid_fade_in()
	await test_hit_mid_fade_in()
	await test_time_scale()
	await test_tree_pause()
	await test_game_pause()
	await test_rivet_alone()
	Input.action_release("rewind")
	print("\n%d checks, %d failed" % [checks, failures])
	quit(failures)

func test_shader_contract() -> void:
	var shader: Shader = load(SHADER_PATH)
	var list := shader.get_shader_uniform_list()
	var by_name := {}
	for u in list:
		by_name[u.name] = u
	print("      uniforms: ", list.map(func(u): return "%s type=%d" % [u.name, u.type]))
	ok(list.size() == 3, "shader parsed: exactly 3 uniforms listed (got %d)" % list.size())
	ok(by_name.has("rewind_amount") and by_name.rewind_amount.type == TYPE_FLOAT, "rewind_amount is a float (type 3)")
	ok(by_name.has("tint_color") and by_name.tint_color.type == TYPE_COLOR, "tint_color is vec4 : source_color (type 20)")
	ok(by_name.has("tint_strength") and by_name.tint_strength.type == TYPE_FLOAT, "tint_strength is a float (type 3)")

	var src := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SHADER_PATH)
	var re := RegEx.new()
	re.compile("uniform\\s+float\\s+rewind_amount\\s*:\\s*hint_range\\(\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*,\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*\\)\\s*=\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*;")
	var m := re.search(src)
	ok(m != null and float(m.get_string(1)) == 0.0 and float(m.get_string(2)) == 1.0 and float(m.get_string(3)) == 0.0,
		"source: rewind_amount hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.0")
	re.compile("uniform\\s+float\\s+tint_strength\\s*:\\s*hint_range\\(\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*,\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*\\)\\s*=\\s*([-\\d.]+)\\s*;")
	m = re.search(src)
	ok(m != null and float(m.get_string(1)) == 0.0 and float(m.get_string(2)) == 1.0 and float(m.get_string(3)) == 0.5,
		"source: tint_strength hint_range(0.0, 1.0) = 0.5")
	re.compile("uniform\\s+vec4\\s+tint_color\\s*:\\s*source_color\\s*=\\s*vec4\\(([^)]*)\\)\\s*;")
	m = re.search(src)
	var c := PackedFloat64Array()
	if m:

	ok(c == PackedFloat64Array([0.353, 0.627, 1.0, 1.0]), "source: tint_color = vec4(0.353, 0.627, 1.0, 1.0) (got %s)" % [c])

## Automated checks for the A5 REWIND tint (CHANGE-BRIEF A5.2, rules R1-R6).
##   scripts/run-test.sh test_rewind_tint.gd <30|60|144>
##
## State is driven through the REAL game loop and input path: rewind is held
## with Input.action_press, pause is a parsed input event, Rivet acts only
## through a brain's think() (the hook rivet_brain.gd uses). The driver's update
## is never called. A Sampler node with process_priority 1000 reads each
## material's `rewind_amount` after every other _process() in the frame.
##
## Headless limits (CLAUDE.md, evidence/a5/headless-facts.txt): nothing is drawn
## and a parameter readback only proves what the driver set, not what the GPU
## shows. Shader defaults are read from the .gdshader text.
## Exit code = number of failed checks.

const SHADER_PATH := "res://shaders/rewind_tint.gdshader"
const FADE_IN := 0.15
const FADE_OUT := 0.30
const EPS := 1e-4

var main
var sampler: Sampler
var failures := 0
var checks := 0
var period := 1.0 / 60.0   # one frame at --fixed-fps, read from the command line

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("run")

func ok(cond: bool, what: String) -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not cond:
		failures += 1
	print(("PASS  " if cond else "FAIL  ") + what)

## Reads both materials after every other _process() (priority 1000), and keeps
## sampling while the tree is paused.
class Sampler extends Node:
	var game
	var t := 0.0
	var samples: Array = []
	func _ready() -> void:
		process_priority = 1000
		process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	func _process(delta: float) -> void:
		t += delta
		if game == null or not is_instance_valid(game) or not game.is_inside_tree():
			return
		log.append({"t": t, "dt": delta,
			"b": game.bolt.sprite.material.get_shader_parameter("rewind_amount"),
			"r": game.rivet.sprite.material.get_shader_parameter("rewind_amount"),
			"bs": game.bolt.state, "rs": game.rivet.state, "gp": game.paused})

class FrozenBrain:
	func think(_dt): pass

## Rivet acts only through intent, like rivet_brain.gd: one jab tick, or held rewind.
class ScriptedBrain:
	var me: Fighter
	var jabs := 0
	var rewind := false
	func think(_dt):
		me.intent = {"move": 0, "jab": jabs > 0, "cutlass": false, "pop": false, "block": false, "rewind": rewind}
		jabs = maxi(0, jabs - 1)

func physics_frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame

func frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await process_frame

## Waits (process frames) until cond(last sample) holds. Returns false on timeout.
func until(cond: Callable, max_frames := 2000) -> bool:
	for i in max_frames:
		await process_frame
		if sampler.samples.size() > 0 and cond.call(sampler.samples[-1]):
			return true
	return false

func press_event(action: String) -> void:
	for pressed in [true, false]:
		var ev := InputEventAction.new()
		ev.action = action
		ev.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(ev)
		await physics_frames(1)

func fresh(brain = null) -> void:
	Input.action_release("rewind")
	if main:
		main.queue_free()
		await physics_frames(2)
	main = load("res://game/main.tscn").instantiate()
	root.add_child(main)
	await physics_frames(2)
	if brain == null:
		brain = FrozenBrain.new()

## Index of the first sample at or after `from` matching cond, or -1.
func find(from: int, cond: Callable) -> int:
	for i in range(from, sampler.samples.size()):
		if cond.call(sampler.samples[i]):
			return i
	return -1

func max_dt(a: int, b: int) -> float:
	var m := 0.0
	for i in range(a, b + 1):
		m = maxf(m, sampler.samples[i].dt)

func direction_follows_state(a: int, b: int, key := "b", state_key := "bs") -> bool:
	for i in range(maxi(a, 1), b + 1):
		var s: Dictionary = sampler.samples[i]
		var prev: float = sampler.samples[i - 1][key]
		if s[key] > prev and s[state_key] != Fighter.S.REWIND:
			return false
		if s[key] < prev and s[state_key] == Fighter.S.REWIND:
			return false
	return true

	for i in range(a, b + 1):

	var start := sampler.samples.size()
	Input.action_press("rewind")
	await until(func(s): return s.b >= 0.3)
	await press_event("pause")
	ok(main.paused, "R4c pause event set main.paused")
	await frames(10)
	var a := find(start, func(s): return s.gp)
	var v: float = sampler.samples[a].b
	var b := sampler.samples.size() - 1
	ok(v < 1.0 and all_equal(a, b, "b", v), "R4c main.paused: value held at %.4f for %d frames" % [v, b - a])
	await press_event("pause")
	ok(not main.paused, "R4c second pause event cleared main.paused")
	var u := find(b, func(s): return not s.gp)
	await until(func(s): return s.b == 1.0)
	var step: float = sampler.samples[u].b - v
	ok(step >= 0.0 and step <= sampler.samples[u].dt / FADE_IN + EPS, "R4c unpaused: resumes from %.4f (first step +%.4f)" % [v, step])
	Input.action_release("rewind")
	await until(func(s): return s.b == 0.0)

func test_rivet_alone() -> void:

	var a := sampler.samples.size()
	brain.rewind = true
	ok(await until(func(s): return s.r == 1.0), "R6 Rivet rewinding: Rivet's value reaches 1.0")
	ok(direction_follows_state(a, sampler.samples.size() - 1, "r", "rs"), "R1 Rivet's value only rises while Rivet is in REWIND")

	ok(await until(func(s): return s.r == 0.0), "R6 Rivet released: Rivet's value returns to 0.0")
